font_type.summary: Typeface family the entire receipt body is rendered in.
font_type.where_to_see_it: Everywhere. Easiest to judge on digits and capitals in the total row -- MERCHANT_COPY is the narrow dot-matrix thermal face, FAKE_RECEIPT and RECEIPTIONAL_RECEIPT are wider and rounder.

merchant_block_position.summary: Vertical position of the block holding the merchant name and address.
merchant_block_position.where_to_see_it: The store name, street, city and phone number. Nearly always the first block under the logo; MIDDLE means it appears after some other block.

logo_placement.summary: Vertical position of the brand logo image, or its absence.
logo_placement.where_to_see_it: The graphic at the very top of most receipts. BOTTOM puts it below the totals, near the thank-you message.

divider_style.summary: Dominant separator character drawn between stacked blocks.
divider_style.where_to_see_it: The horizontal rules splitting header from items from totals. EMPTY is a blank line rather than a drawn rule; NONE means blocks abut directly.

total_divider_style.summary: Separator drawn immediately above the grand-total row.
total_divider_style.where_to_see_it: The rule between the last line item (or tax row) and the TOTAL line.

total_emphasis.summary: Font-size increase applied to the grand-total row relative to body text.
total_emphasis.where_to_see_it: The TOTAL line. PERCENT_50 renders it half again as large; NONE keeps it the same size as the line items above it.

layout_signature.summary: The ordered sequence of block types -- the layout itself.
layout_signature.where_to_see_it: Read top to bottom down the receipt. HEADER|ITEMS|CUSTOM is logo and address, then the purchase table, then a footer message.

money_row_order.summary: Order in which semantic money rows appear across the whole receipt.
money_row_order.where_to_see_it: The arithmetic column. ITEM>SUBTOTAL>TAX>TOTAL>TENDER>CHANGE is the classic supermarket order; NONE means the receipt shows no priced rows.

quantity_column.summary: Whether line items render a leading quantity column.
quantity_column.where_to_see_it: The left edge of the item table -- a '2' before the product name. NO_ITEMS covers receipts with no itemised purchase table at all.

barcode_placement.summary: Vertical position of the barcode block, or its absence.
barcode_placement.where_to_see_it: The scannable stripe, usually near the foot of the receipt below the totals and above or below the thank-you message.

number_format.summary: Horizontal alignment of the amount column.
number_format.where_to_see_it: The price column on the right. LEFT ragged-aligns the amounts; RIGHT and RIGHT_SPACE align them flush so decimal points line up.

background_type.summary: Paper texture composited behind the rendered text.
background_type.where_to_see_it: The substrate itself -- crumple pattern, shadowing and creases. Purely a photorealism treatment; it does not move any content.

header_alignment.summary: Text alignment inside the header block.
header_alignment.where_to_see_it: The merchant name and address lines. CENTER is the thermal-printer norm; LEFT reads more like an invoice.

section_count.summary: Number of stacked blocks making up the receipt.
section_count.where_to_see_it: A proxy for overall complexity and length -- count the visually distinct bands from logo to footer.
